product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides enterprises with a cloud networking and security platform for connecting, controlling, and securing workloads across multicloud environments.
product_one_liner.notes: Aviatrix documentation describes cloud networking software for building cloud backbones and linking cloud regions/providers/data centers, while the platform supports secure connections. Framed for enterprise/multicloud users.

pricing_page.notes: The company has an official public page explicitly titled Pricing that lists pricing and plan details.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The featured customers page shows case studies for Better and Anheuser-Busch InBev, identifying both as customers. | named_customers.0: The featured customers page names Better and links its customer case study. | named_customers.1: The featured customers page names Anheuser-Busch InBev and links its customer case study.

employee_band.notes: Inc. reports company size 201–500, matching the permitted employee band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: LinkedIn company profile directly reports headquarters as Santa Clara, California; the city field is Santa Clara. | hq_country: Aviatrix’s company profile directly gives its headquarters as Santa Clara, CA, United States.

founded_year.notes: Inc. company profile states Aviatrix was founded in 2014 and identifies Santa Clara as its location.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index establishes a company blog, and separate technical deep-dive posts by a Technical Marketing Engineer describe the data plane and cloud firewall implementation, satisfying the threshold of two technical posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Aviatrix documentation site contains setup guides, security, monitoring, networking topics, and API documentation—several product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete Greenhouse listing shows job titles, with 16 total roles and none titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision. Hence false.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (ChatGPT); Aviatrix also says it uses other providers’ models without naming them.
model_provider.notes: Aviatrix CEO states the company uses OpenAI technology for some features, continues using ChatGPT, and also uses other providers’ models without naming them. This supports naming OpenAI/ChatGPT but not an exhaustive list of additional providers.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company Trust Center lists SOC 2, GDPR, and ISO 27001 among its audits/certifications; these are the named matching items from the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 appears in the Aviatrix Trust Center audits/certifications list. | compliance_certs.1: GDPR appears in the Aviatrix Trust Center audits/certifications list. | compliance_certs.2: ISO 27001 appears in the Aviatrix Trust Center audits/certifications list.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest row in the funding history is explicitly labeled “Series Unknown.” | funding_date: The funding history table lists a Series Unknown round in December 2022, which is later than the listed Series E in September 2021. The date is normalized to YYYY-MM. | funding_amount_usd: The source row for the latest December 2022 round provides no amount (shown as unavailable), so the numeric amount is unknown and represented as null.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent listed funding round is dated December 2022, outside the 18-month window preceding November 9, 2026; therefore Aviatrix did not raise within that window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists an Inside Sales Representative opening, and its live posting describes prospecting, pipeline creation, and closing; this falls within sales representative hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix’s dated October 26, 2026 press release announces the launch of Clearance, within six months before the requested November 9, 2026 reference date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full current leadership roster lists the executive team; dated announcement confirms key changes in June 2025, before the 12-month window beginning November 2025. The sources found no later C-level/VP appointment/departure in the window, so the roster check supports false.
